principle: Location only. Function, seniority and experience are each person's own choices (include/exclude, rubric): a wrongly rejected posting is never scored, so nobody ever learns it was good.

rules.note: Non-EU location or non-EU remote (section 1). Must run BEFORE HARD_LOCATION: 'United States, Remote' satisfies a bare 'remote' requirement, so without this rule every US-remote posting passes.
Berlin on-site/hybrid or EU-remote (section 1). Skipped when the feed gives no location - unknown is not disqualifying. Bare 'remote' passes here only because the non-EU rule above has already run.
